key.name: tiling-mode
key.summary: Default tiling mode for workspaces.
key.description: Whether a workspace tiles by default, until its mode is toggled from the top bar. Per-workspace overrides are stored in tiling-workspace-modes.

key.name: tiling-workspace-modes
key.summary: Per-workspace tiling mode overrides (JSON).
key.description: JSON object mapping workspace index to a boolean tiling mode, e.g. {"0":true,"1":false}. Workspaces without an entry follow tiling-mode.

key.name: tiling-warp-pointer
key.summary: Move the pointer to the focused window's centre.
key.description: When tiling, warp the mouse pointer to the centre of the focused window so it follows keyboard focus.

key.name: tiling-gaps-inner
key.summary: Gap between tiled windows, in pixels.
key.description: Gap between tiled windows, in pixels.

key.name: tiling-gaps-outer
key.summary: Gap between tiled windows and the screen edge, in pixels.
key.description: Gap between tiled windows and the screen edge, in pixels.

key.name: tiling-default-layout

key.name: tiling-rules-json
key.summary: Imported for_window/assign rules, serialized as JSON.
key.description: Imported for_window/assign rules, serialized as JSON.

key.name: scratchpad-visible
key.summary: Whether a scratchpad window is currently shown.
key.description: Whether a scratchpad window is currently shown.

key.name: tiling-overridden-state
key.summary: Persisted backup of GNOME shortcuts/features the tiler overrides.
key.description: Internal: JSON snapshot of the GNOME keybindings and mutter flags cleared while tiling is on, so they survive an unclean shutdown and can be restored.

key.name: keybind-overridden-state
key.summary: Persisted backup of GNOME shortcuts cleared for the whole extension.
key.description: Internal: JSON snapshot of the GNOME keybindings (Super+H minimize, Super+L screensaver) cleared whenever the extension is loaded, since those keys drive directional focus in both free and tiling modes.

key.name: tiling-restore-app-size
key.summary: Reopen apps at their pre-tiling size.
key.description: Remember each app's natural size before it is tiled, and re-apply it when a window of that app later opens while tiling is off — so an app closed while tiled does not reopen at its small grid size.
